mapper.insert:
insert into settlement_detail (claim_id, entry_kind, event_key, batch_id, merchant_id, source_type, source_id, receiver_type, receiver_id, gross_amount, commission_amount, settlement_amount, status, fail_reason, idempotency_key, create_time) values
(#{item.claimId}, #{item.entryKind}, #{item.eventKey}, #{item.batchId}, #{item.merchantId}, #{item.sourceType}, #{item.sourceId}, #{item.receiverType}, #{item.receiverId}, #{item.grossAmount}, #{item.commissionAmount}, #{item.settlementAmount}, #{item.status}, #{item.failReason}, #{item.idempotencyKey}, now())
mapper.select: select id, claim_id, entry_kind, event_key, batch_id, merchant_id, source_type, source_id, receiver_type, receiver_id, gross_amount, commission_amount, settlement_amount, status, fail_reason, idempotency_key, create_time, update_time from settlement_detail where source_type = #{sourceType} and source_id = #{sourceId} and status = 1 order by id desc limit 1

select id, claim_id, entry_kind, event_key, batch_id, merchant_id, source_type, source_id, receiver_type, receiver_id, gross_amount, commission_amount, settlement_amount, status, fail_reason, idempotency_key, create_time, update_time from settlement_detail where source_type = #{sourceType} and source_id = #{sourceId} and status in (0, 1) order by id asc
mapper.insert: insert ignore into settlement_detail (claim_id, entry_kind, event_key, batch_id, merchant_id, source_type, source_id, receiver_type, receiver_id, gross_amount, commission_amount, settlement_amount, status, fail_reason, idempotency_key, create_time) values (#{claimId}, #{entryKind}, #{eventKey}, #{batchId}, #{merchantId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{receiverType}, #{receiverId}, #{grossAmount}, #{commissionAmount}, #{settlementAmount}, #{status}, #{failReason}, #{idempotencyKey}, now())
mapper.select: select id, claim_id, entry_kind, event_key, batch_id, merchant_id, source_type, source_id, receiver_type, receiver_id, gross_amount, commission_amount, settlement_amount, status, fail_reason, idempotency_key, create_time, update_time from settlement_detail where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} for update
mapper.sql: and not exists ( select 1 from cms_registration r join cms_topic t on t.id = r.owner_id where settlement_detail.source_type = 'registration' and r.id = settlement_detail.source_id and r.owner_type = 1 and (t.end_date is null or t.end_date > date_sub(now(), interval 7 day)) )
mapper.select:
select id, claim_id, entry_kind, event_key, batch_id, merchant_id, source_type, source_id, receiver_type, receiver_id, gross_amount, commission_amount, settlement_amount, status, fail_reason, idempotency_key, create_time, update_time from settlement_detail where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and batch_id = 0 and status = 0
order by id asc
mapper.update: update settlement_detail set batch_id = #{batchId}, update_time = now() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and batch_id = 0 and status = 0
update settlement_detail set status = 1, update_time = now() where batch_id = #{batchId} and status = 0

update settlement_detail set status = 1, update_time = now() where source_type = 'registration' and status = 0 and source_id in ( select id from cms_registration where owner_id = #{activityId} and owner_type = 2 and payment_status = 2 and registration_status = 2 ) and not exists ( select 1 from cms_activity_settlement_hold h where h.registration_id = settlement_detail.source_id and h.status = 0 )
update settlement_detail set status = 1, update_time = now() where source_type = 'registration' and status = 0 and source_id = #{registrationId}
mapper.delete: delete from settlement_detail where source_type = 'coupon' and source_id = #{sourceId} and batch_id = 0 and status = 0
mapper.select: select #{merchantId} as merchant_id, coalesce(sum(case when status = 1 and source_type != 'refund' then settlement_amount else 0 end), 0) as settled_amount, coalesce(-sum(case when source_type = 'refund' then settlement_amount else 0 end), 0) as reversal_amount, coalesce(sum(case when status = 1 and source_type != 'refund' then settlement_amount else 0 end), 0) - coalesce(-sum(case when source_type = 'refund' then settlement_amount else 0 end), 0) as net_amount from settlement_detail where merchant_id = #{merchantId}
